summary: One overapplied native occurrence can authorize multiple returned-call residuals
evidence: At reviewed HEAD 09b28234d07fa612cdd3f62060dfea434e1bc4fc, an independently compiled fixture has two same-line wrapped calls in run_mixed, with native occurrence IDs [2,3] and supplied counts [1,2], against syntactic arity 1. Real probe replay and loadWitness accept residual head_index [1,1] twice; compareSnapshots then returns ok:true and residuals:2 because returnCapacity is aggregated by canonical transition pair. The same test first accepts the legitimate mixed-group residual [1], and a second run_both group with supplied counts [2,2] and distinct residual head indices [0,1]. Compiler exits 0; the final refusal assertion exits 1, not setup failure. Temporary reproduction: /tmp/arch-index-owner-residual-5bLLl3/repro.js and native.ml. Positioned snapshots are explicitly synthesized admission controls from real native evidence, not actual database snapshots. The checked fixed410 witness has no residuals, so this finding does not demonstrate a false retained corpus gain.
fix: Consume each residual head_index at most once inside loadWitness and reject reuse before returning approved residuals. Preserve the existing transition occurrence and complete-group checks. Add the authentic mixed-group reuse refusal plus both positive controls; do not require new witnesses for unchanged pre-existing residual rows.

summary: CHECK1 does not exercise the claimed complete rich/effectful-open preservation boundary
evidence: The exact rich comparisons cover only alias_call, callback, local_call, nested_call, parameter_effect and parameter_partial. native-check-probe.ml calls both collectors without value_channels, so carrier/value-scope/origin preservation is vacuous. It compares in-memory lambda/effect structures, not complete paired stored rich facts. The only computed-open fixture is F.computed: the native row probe iterates top-level Tstr_value only and the flat probe's explicit names omit F.computed and F.computed_call. Moreover that computed module structure contains no effectful call; module application and unpack open controls are absent. parameter_partial is a bare alias rather than an actual partial application. The four registered Tezt cases check selected target/count/drop/flat assertions and do not close these gaps. Therefore the passing CHECK1 result does not establish AC5/7/8 and FR023/025/032 as claimed; no product regression in these cases is asserted.
fix: Add non-vacuous paired rich and duplicate-sensitive flat controls covering effectful module-structure/application/unpack opens, actual partial/full optional and refutable-parameter calls, configured value-channel carriers/scopes/origins, and unrelated same-name flat callees. Compare unchanged stored ownership/CFG/scope/origin/function facts with the predecessor, permitting only the specified target transitions and residuals. Retain the existing positive/refusal controls and spec requirements.
